role: One-slot async frame buffer for MJPEG debug camera overlay streaming
detail: Exports DebugFrameStore class: a thread-safe single-frame buffer holding the latest annotated and raw JPEG bytes from the perception pipeline. put(annotated, raw) overwrites prior frames; get_annotated() and get_raw() retrieve the latest stored frames (or None). Internally uses asyncio.Lock for thread-safe concurrent access. Policy: only the most recent frame is retained; older frames are silently dropped. No retention history, no queuing. Designed for polling-based MJPEG streaming where clients fetch the latest frame on-demand.
gotchas: Single-slot design means frames can be lost if producer writes faster than consumer reads; no backpressure or queueing. None-safe API (get_* return None if put() never called).
